data.body:
Investigation RESULT (INTERMEDIATE tier, opus): all 4 claims CONFIRMED with file:line evidence.

ROOT_CAUSE: Sessions creating PRs stamp no session-identifying marker (merge-to-main-pr.sh:428-429 produces body 'Auto-generated PR for branch ...' with no trailer). Downstream destructive call sites (merge-to-main-pr.sh:437/549/1295, debug-everything/SKILL.md:1175, phase-10-merge-verify.md:51, end-session/SKILL.md:242) all resolve target PR purely by 'gh pr list --head $(git branch --show-current)' with no ownership check. CLAUDE_SESSION_ID env var exists (consumed only by suggestion-record.sh:127) but is not propagated to PR metadata; SPRINT_SESSION_ID is branch-derived and collapses on the same surface as the bug. No CLAUDE.md rule prohibits destructive actions on PRs the current session did not create.

PROPOSED FIX (for brainstorm to evaluate): stamp Session-Id trailer (re-using CLAUDE_SESSION_ID) into PR body at create, add pr-owned-by-session.sh helper invoked by all destructive sites (fail-closed), add CLAUDE.md rule prohibiting destructive PR actions without ownership check. Alternative: GitHub PR labels (dso-session:<id-prefix>) for robust against body edits; tradeoff is per-repo label setup. Hybrid recommended.

FIX COMPLEXITY: COMPLEX — 6 files / 4 subsystems (scripts, skills+sub-agent prompts, CLAUDE.md policy, new helper script). Phase D Step 2 triggers: 5+ files / 3+ subsystems AND skill+script edits required AND new policy rule AND new primitive script.

PRIOR ART: Co-Authored-By trailer in commits, DSO-Story: trailer (sprint), DEFENSE_RECORD in PR comments. None currently in PR bodies.

Escalating to /dso:brainstorm per Phase D Step 2.
